## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED. First revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB defects):
1. As in task 0: the title_receipt chargeback-timing sentence is declared retired by two extended policies' overwrites while tradein_ext_title_delay_chargeback restates it as its own rule; the KB shows it retired in title_receipt_and_chargeback_period and in force in title_delay_chargeback_posting, exactly as the source has it.
2. The baseline "the amount paid today is the whole shortfall" sits beside the rule "A customer who asks to spread the shortfall pays today's installment at once …"; the spreading is delivered by the installment-count factor. Faithful to the source's baseline/factor split; recorded only because a baseline-only reader would compute the whole shortfall even for a customer who asked to spread.

## dependency_form

- Both prerequisite sentences appear exactly once, verbatim, in the blocked hub, state form intact; the heading "Ledger entries today's installment rests on" and "Both are read from the agreement's own history: today's installment is worked out against a ledger that already shows those entries where they are owed." are same-form restatements of the blocked policy's own sentences in its own document — they name no action, performer, tool or other document.
- The opening "A title-delay chargeback can leave the trade equity … below zero; the customer then owes that shortfall and may pay it at once or spread it." describes the subject generally; no route.
- towing_fee_deduction_booking "The waiting period after pickup that holds back a title-delay chargeback does not hold back a towing deduction." — source rule text, a non-dependency.
- No other problem's tool name in the blocked hub (only `pay_chargeback_shortfall_4672c84f`); no checklist, route, step list or example crossing problems; no wrong-vs-right chain contrast.
- Titles general ("Paying a Title-Delay Chargeback Shortfall — Trade-In Agreements", "Title-Delay Chargebacks on Trade-In Agreements", "Towing Fee Deductions — Trade-In Agreements", "Collections Desk Note: Towing Fees Within Trade-In Shortfall Installments"); none mirrors the task.
- Computation documents (towing_deduction_calculation, title_delay_chargeback_amount, chargeback_shortfall_amount_due_today) carry no modification hint or pointer; "standard included tow miles / standard per-mile tow rate" is the source baseline's own wording. Factor documents name no other document and assign no customer to a tier.
- Findability: depended-on documents reachable through "title-delay chargeback", "title received date", "towing fee", "tow truck"; factor documents reachable from record words (title order lienholder/status, autopay_ach payments, delivery method/distance/completed date, pickup weekday, KestrelCare on the purchase, Tier B, vehicle_price charges, posting dates) — confirmed in the blind audit.

Verdict: **PASS** (no KB-EXPLICIT RED).
